title: Revisiting Self-Play Preference Optimization: On the Role of Prompt Difficulty
authors_zh: Yao Xiao, Jung-jae Kim, Roy Ka-wei Lee, Lidong Bing
paper_type_zh: 自博弈偏好优化的提示难度选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合在构造偏好对前，需要先为自博弈 DPO 流程过滤提示、节省轨迹与奖励模型预算的读者。
one_line: The paper improves self-play DPO by ranking prompts with mean reward and retaining only the easiest 30 percent rather than mixing in difficult prompts.
该论文以平均奖励排序提示，仅保留最容易的 30% 来构造自博弈 DPO 偏好对。
why: It identifies the prompt as a first-class consumer-side decision in preference-data construction, not just a container for response sampling.
inclusion_reason: It changes which prompts are permitted to generate self-play preference pairs, showing that prompt difficulty changes the utility of the downstream DPO data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Self-play preference optimization usually focuses on how to select responses, while every prompt is treated as equally suitable for producing DPO data. Difficult prompts can yield weak or unreliable preference pairs even after reward-model ranking.

The paper asks which prompts should be allowed to consume self-play sampling and preference-optimization budget. It treats low mean reward across sampled responses as a model-relative difficulty signal.

自博弈偏好优化通常关注如何选择回答，却把每条提示都视为同样适合生成 DPO 数据。困难提示即使经过奖励模型排序，也可能产生弱或不可靠的偏好对。

论文要回答的是，哪些提示应被允许消耗自博弈采样与偏好优化预算。它把多次采样回答的低平均奖励视为模型相对的难度信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For each prompt, the policy samples several responses and a reward model scores them. Their mean reward ranks prompt difficulty: lower means harder for the present model.

The central result is that hard prompts do not help the reported self-play DPO setting. Pruning them and retaining the easiest subset produces better final alignment than using the full pool.

对每条提示，策略采样多个回答，奖励模型为其评分。它们的平均奖励用于排序提示难度：平均值越低，对当前模型越困难。

核心结果是，困难提示不会帮助所报告的自博弈 DPO 设置。剪除它们、保留最容易子集，比使用完整提示池带来更好的最终对齐。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method samples ten responses per prompt, scores them with a reward model, and uses the mean as difficulty. The maximum-scored response becomes chosen and the minimum-scored response rejected for DPO.

Prompts are partitioned by difficulty and compared under DPO. The successful compact rule retains the easiest 30 percent; the authors also test easy-to-hard curriculum and improving difficult chosen responses.

该方法对每条提示采样十个回答，用奖励模型评分，并以平均值表示难度。最高分回答成为 DPO 的被选项，最低分回答成为被拒项。

提示按难度分组并在 DPO 下比较。成功的紧凑规则保留最容易的 30%；作者也测试了由易到难课程和改善困难提示被选回答。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The hardest quartile performs worse than equally sized easier prompt subsets, and adding it to easier data does not improve the reported DPO outcomes. Performance rises as prompts become easier.

On AlpacaEval 2 and Arena-Hard, retaining 30 percent easiest prompts beats the full and random retained sets in the paper's comparisons. The paper also reports failed curriculum and chosen-response interventions.

最困难四分位的表现差于同样大小的较容易提示子集，把它加入较容易数据也不会提升所报告的 DPO 结果。提示越容易，性能越高。

在 AlpacaEval 2 和 Arena-Hard 上，论文比较中保留最容易的 30% 优于全量和随机保留集。论文也报告课程和被选回答干预的失败尝试。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper moves selection upstream from responses to prompts. A prompt is judged by the expected quality of its whole self-play response distribution, not by one selected answer.

It also reports negative results: easy-to-hard ordering and better chosen answers for hard prompts did not solve the hard-prompt issue in its setting.

论文把选择从回答上游移到提示。提示依据其完整自博弈回答分布的预期质量判断，而不是依据一个被选回答。

它也报告负结果：在其设置中，由易到难排序和改善困难提示的被选回答都没有解决困难提示问题。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Difficulty depends on reward-model scores and model capacity, so the cutoff may not transfer. The study concerns a particular self-play DPO pipeline and does not release code or selected prompts.
难度依赖奖励模型分数和模型能力，因此截断点未必可迁移。研究针对特定自博弈 DPO 流程，且没有发布代码或所选提示。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper before generating expensive self-play preference pairs. It supports ranking prompts with the same policy and reward model, then allocating rollout budget to prompts likely to yield separable preference evidence.
应在生成昂贵的自博弈偏好对之前使用本文。它支持用同一策略和奖励模型排序提示，再把轨迹预算分配给更可能产生可分偏好证据的提示。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read it as evidence that prompt selection is part of preference-data construction. Separate its empirical pruning result from a universal claim that hard data is useless; the paper itself finds a model-capacity interaction.
应把本文理解为提示选择属于偏好数据构造的证据。要把经验性的剪枝结果与“困难数据无用”的普遍主张分开；论文自身发现它与模型能力有关。
